preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within bounds 1 ≤ a_i ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 * t + sum(int(n) for n in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Input format matches exactly t test cases, each with n followed by n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(a[0] == '1' for a in [line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: First element of each sequence a is always 1 (root).

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(a)) == n for a in [line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: All elements in each sequence a are unique (no duplicates).

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly t integers, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(h) <= n for h in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output height h is within bounds 1 ≤ h ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(h) == min_height(a) for h, a in zip(stdout.split(), [line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output height h is the minimum possible height of a tree with BFS order a.
